name: DDIM (20 steps)
tagline: Deterministic implicit reverse-process solver from DDIM, run at 20 inference steps inside CleanDiffuser's DiscreteDiffusionSDE.
diff_from_baseline: Song et al. 2021 (DDIM, ICLR). Deterministic non-Markov reverse process; 5x fewer steps than the DDPM default (100) while maintaining most of the quality.

name: DPM-Solver++ 2M (10 steps)
tagline: High-order multistep ODE solver tuned for guided sampling; second-order multistep variant at just 10 NFE.
diff_from_baseline: Lu et al. 2022 (DPM-Solver++, arXiv:2211.01095). High-order multistep ODE solver that converges with very few NFE; 10x fewer steps than DDPM and 2x fewer than DDIM.

name: DDPM (100 steps)
tagline: Default ancestral DDPM reverse-process solver at 100 steps — the unmodified template baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Ho et al. 2020 (DDPM, NeurIPS). Default ancestral sampler; high-quality but slow. The unmodified CleanDiffuser template baseline against which fast samplers are compared.
